versions.subject: feat: aspnet compile + agentexecutor rename
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '\aspnet_compiler.exe'
    TargetFilename|contains|all:
        - '\Temporary ASP.NET Files\'
        - '\assembly\tmp\'
        - '.dll'
condition: selection
versions.spl: Image="*\\aspnet_compiler.exe" TargetFilename="*\\Temporary ASP.NET Files\\*" TargetFilename="*\\assembly\\tmp\\*" TargetFilename="*.dll*"
